title: The Python solvers with an adaptive step size from the recommended step size
author: Claude-JG
description: SolveGeneralizedAlpha and SolveExplicit of exudyn.symbolics.solvers keep the step size fixed and ignore the recommended step size the post-Newton functions return. Decided: the step reduced to the recommended size and grown again, as the discontinuous iteration of the C++ solvers does.
releaseNotes: SolveGeneralizedAlpha and SolveExplicit repeat a step with the recommended step size of a post-Newton step and grow the step again, as Exudyn's solvers with timeIntegration.adaptiveStep; test model symbolicSolversAdaptiveStepTest.
